name: Summarizer
description: Summarizer tool. Convert raw meeting notes or transcripts into clean, organized minutes and action items.

howToUse:
1. Paste your raw meeting notes or transcript.
2. Select your desired Summary Format (e.g., Action Items, Full Minutes).
3. Click 'SUMMARIZE'.
4. Copy the structured results.
features:
• Auto-extract action items
• Multiple languages
• Structure conversion
